newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit steady as mkt focuses on dollar/majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit steady as mkt focuses on dollar/majors.

text.p: The ringgit made mild gains but stayed within a tight range as activity in the regional currencies fell due to focus on dollar/majors, dealers said.
They said holiday in the U.S. and London on Monday was expected to keep trading subdued for the day.
"There are no new factors to trade on in the regionals. Thai baht is very quiet so there is a spillover effect on other regionals," said a dealer with a European bank in Singapore.
He said the market was focusing on the French elections, where losses for President Jacques Chirac's coalition was causing a mild selloff in the dollar/mark.
The head of foreign exchange dealing at a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur said dollar/ringgit would trade in a 30-point range for most of the day.
At 0200 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4992/02 to a dollar.
